task: Issue #587: loki-canary DaemonSet runs on every node although loki.yaml sets lokiCanary.enabled: false. Find correct key in chart 18.4.0 (top-level lokiCanary.enabled: false), ensure canary is removed and nothing depends on it, pin with R315.

events.summary: Change only lokiCanary.enabled configuration in loki.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh to top-level, add regression check R315 with mutation verify, lessons-log row, and trace. D-LOKI-CANARY-DISABLE: moved lokiCanary.enabled: false to top-level valuesObject in loki.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh, removing invalid monitoring: block. Verified no alerts or dashboards reference loki-canary, and PR #586 anti-affinity explicitly targets component=single-binary.
